Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • He can now inflict bleed on his primary target, starting Halloween update.
  • After the release of Blood (Unleashed) he can deal much higher DPS because Blood (Unleashed)] buffs all bleed damage by 5x. This buff combined with Levi’s 50% CRIT chance to deal 2x Damage makes him a pretty solid unit, although he can't do extra bleed damage to flying enemies due to Blood (Unleashed) not being able to hit flying enemies.
  • Lex Akoman is the only crit unit in the game that deals 2x damage on crit unlike the usual 1.5x most units have.
